categories.main_business_segments: Entegris operates through four primary business segments: Specialty Chemicals and Engineered Materials (SCEM), Microcontamination Control (MC), Advanced Materials Handling (AMH), and Advanced Planarization Solutions (APS). Each segment aligns with a key element of the advanced semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem, offering products and solutions that address critical steps in chip fabrication and related high-technology industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced material science, high-purity chemical synthesis, specialty coatings, engineered polymers, filtration and purification technologies, and precision manufacturing. Production methods include chemical formulation, blending, distillation, membrane casting, advanced cleanroom procedures, and automated manufacturing with statistical process controls to ensure ultra-high purity and consistency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Entegris primarily serves logic and memory semiconductor device manufacturers, semiconductor equipment makers, gas and chemical suppliers, and wafer growers. Additional markets include outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) facilities, flat panel display manufacturers, hard disk drive producers, solar, life sciences, aerospace, and other high-technology industries requiring advanced materials and contamination control.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint, with significant operations and sales in North America, Taiwan, China, South Korea, Japan, Europe, and Southeast Asia. In 2022, 76% of net sales were international, with major manufacturing and R&D facilities across the US, Asia, and Europe, and ongoing investments in new facilities in Taiwan and Colorado, USA.
categories.supply_chain_position: Entegris operates primarily as a midstream and downstream supplier within the semiconductor supply chain, providing mission-critical materials, consumables, and process solutions that are integrated into customers’ manufacturing processes. The company also supplies upstream to chemical manufacturers and downstream to device makers and equipment OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing technology leadership in materials purity and process solutions, expanding the breadth and integration of its product portfolio, and investing heavily in R&D for next-generation semiconductor nodes and architectures. The company emphasizes customer collaboration, co-optimized solutions, and regional manufacturing resiliency, with R&D spending at 7% of net sales in 2022 and a focus on innovation for advanced logic, memory, and adjacent markets.
categories.revenue_model: Entegris generates revenue primarily through the sale of consumable products, materials, and process solutions that are used and replaced regularly in semiconductor manufacturing. Approximately 80% of revenue is recurring or unit-driven, with additional revenue from equipment sales, licensing, and services. The company also enters into supply agreements, though most sales are based on non-binding forecasts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include Pall Corporation (Danaher), Shin-Etsu Polymer, Merck KGaA (EMD Performance Materials), DuPont, Air Liquide, Linde, Anji Microelectronics, and Mersen. Entegris is differentiated by its broad, integrated product portfolio and technology leadership, with no single global competitor matching its full range of offerings. The company is positioned as a strategic supplier with strong customer relationships and a diverse customer base.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Entegris reported net sales of $3.28 billion, a 43% increase from 2021, driven by organic growth and the acquisition of CMC Materials. Adjusted EBITDA was $973 million (29.7% margin), and net income was $209 million. The company has demonstrated strong growth, both organically and through acquisitions, but also carries significant debt following recent acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Entegris delivers unique value through its comprehensive portfolio of high-purity materials, contamination control, and advanced process solutions that enable higher semiconductor yields, lower manufacturing costs, and improved device performance. Its integrated, co-optimized solutions, deep technical expertise, and strong customer collaboration make switching costly for customers and position Entegris as a trusted, mission-critical supplier in the semiconductor ecosystem.
